title: Data Validation Plan
description: Dialect-neutral validation plan containing ordered checks with pass/fail criteria, severity levels, and input column references. Generated from a validation contract and rendered into engine-specific SQL by the DV renderer.

plan_version.description: Semantic version of the validation plan schema (e.g., '1.0.0')

table_type.description: Target table type classification from intent identification

engine.description: SQL engine for routing to the correct dialect renderer (Athena SQL or Databricks SQL)

check_id.description: Unique check identifier. Prefix denotes category: ER=exact_reconciliation, SCD2=scd2_temporal, NC=null_check, DC=duplicate_check, DT=datatype_check, BR=business_rule.

category.description: Check category for grouping and filtering

description.description: Human-readable description of what this check validates

input_columns.description: Target column names referenced by this check

pass_criteria.description: Condition that must hold for the check to pass (e.g., 'source_count == target_count')

not_evaluated_conditions.description: Conditions under which this check is marked NOT_EVALUATED rather than PASS/FAIL (e.g., 'source table empty', 'crypto column — values not comparable')

severity.description: Severity level: blocker halts sign-off, warning is advisory but does not block

parameters.description: Additional check-specific parameters (e.g., tolerance thresholds, aggregation functions, filter expressions)

temporal_invariant.description: SCD2 temporal invariant specification. Present only for scd2_temporal category checks.

date_columns.description: Date columns involved in the invariant (e.g., ['eff_start_dt', 'eff_end_dt'])

sentinel_value.description: High-end date sentinel for current records (e.g., '3499-12-31')

checks.description: Ordered array of validation checks to execute

assumptions_and_gaps.description: Known assumptions, data gaps, or limitations that may affect validation accuracy (e.g., 'crypto columns excluded from value comparison', 'no source profiling data available')
